summary: End-to-end testing of the new BotNira Email channel (IMAP polling + SMTP outbound). 23/23 backend pytest cases pass; all critical frontend flows verified for kamal (exempt vendor). Endpoint contracts, validation, auth gating, password-encryption-at-rest, and the connect-form UX (incl. real bad-creds toast surfacing 'IMAP login failed') are all working correctly. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4733 lines — way past the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into modules (billing.py, voice.py, email.py, sms.py, auth.py, admin.py, conversations.py). The Email channel alone occupies ~600 lines (3748–4344) and is self-contained; it would be the easiest first extraction.
PUT /api/email/settings does not allow updating IMAP/SMTP host/port post-connect — vendor would have to disconnect+reconnect to re-key. Low-priority, but would be a nice ergonomic improvement.

_email_poll_once iterates connections sequentially (await per vendor) — fine for MVP but won't scale beyond ~50 active inboxes per 60s window. Consider asyncio.gather with a concurrency cap when vendor count grows.

Idempotency check in _process_inbound_email looks at db.messages.find_one({vendor_id, external_id}) — good. But messages with no Message-ID header (rare) skip the check entirely (`if msg_id:` gate) — could cause duplicates in pathological cases. Consider a (vendor_id, conversation_id, body_hash, last_5min) fallback.

_verify_imap_smtp_sync calls .login on Gmail/Outlook — these providers will silently rate-limit / block after repeated bad-cred attempts from the same IP. Not a bug, but a known operational risk; document in vendor-facing help text.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 — all email channel pytest cases pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical email-panel UI flows verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. The test_email_channel.py auto-disconnects kamal's email (idempotent) before status/settings tests, so it leaves the DB in the same state it was in before the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_email_channel.py -v. All 23 cases passing. The poller runs every 60s in the background — confirmed by '[email] poller started (every 60s)' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Endpoint contracts validated: connect rejects unknown domains with 400 'auto-detect' message, gmail bad creds returns 400 'IMAP login failed', status returns {connected:false} when disconnected and strips password_encrypted when connected, settings returns 404 when no connection, poll-now returns 400 when not connected, send returns 400 for missing payload and 404 for non-existent conv, admin role rejected by all /api/email/* endpoints. UI verified end-to-end: email channel card on /app/channels shows 'See the Email panel below to connect your inbox.' for kamal; the [data-testid=email-panel] renders with connect form below the Voice panel; advanced toggle reveals [data-testid=email-advanced-block]; submitting test@gmail.com + wrongpassword surfaces the backend toast 'IMAP login failed: b'[AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Invalid credentials (Failure)''. Password encryption-at-rest verified by direct MongoDB inspection (any docs in email_connections start with Fernet's gAAAAA prefix).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature is production-ready from a contract + UX standpoint. Caveat: the only path that could not be exercised end-to-end is a successful IMAP connect (no real test inbox supplied), and inbound email idempotency (poller code path is verified by reading; runtime would need a real inbound message).
